Parcel Info - Update
Parcel Info - Update
Data from this site is now incorporated into the new Tax Parcel Viewer app on the Koochiching County website. Within this app, you can find a basic assessment report, obtain your annual tax statement, and pay your taxes online. Search by parcel ID, owner name or address.
Questions about assessment information call: (218) 283-1110
Questions about tax statements or payments call: (218) 283-1110
Questions about map data call: (218) 283-1172
